services.value: Provides environmental analytical laboratory services, including organic and inorganic analyses of water, groundwater, storm water, wastewater, soil and hazardous waste samples, and analyzes solid and aqueous materials to identify hazardous constituents. Also lists services such as hazardous waste characterization, UST removal analyses, Ground Water well monitoring and analysis, sludge analysis, priority pollutant scans, TCLP scans, NPDES permit monitoring, VOC/SVOC analyses, pesticides/herbicides/PCBs/metals/wet chemistry analyses, and method development and validation.
